name: Bio Green Energy Tech Public Company Limited
summary: Bio Green Energy Tech Public Company Limited, along with its subsidiaries, delivers maritime transport solutions both within Thailand and across global markets. Their services encompass time charters, comprehensive ship management (including vessel operations and crew provision), and semi-liner shipping. The company also offers specialized marine-related services, such as brokerage for cargo bookings, facilitating the buying and selling of ships, and arranging vessel charters. Additionally, a notable part of their business involves the production and distribution of biodiesel and glycerin. Established in 1976, the firm was previously known as Jutha Maritime Public Company Limited before officially adopting its current name, Bio Green Energy Tech Public Company Limited, in May 2022. Its corporate headquarters are located in Bangkok, Thailand.
